title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval a 365 Day firm Transportation Agreement between Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan energy Delivery New England and Union Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Deparment Approves the proposed Agreement. The departments finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclousre. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-11)
